title: Grateful Dead Live at Sportatorium on 1985-10-25
lineage: MAC playback on Nakamichi DR-2 tape deck > Presonus Firebox  > firewire out > P4 2.0 GHz PC, recorded as 24 bit/96 KHz WAV on PC utilizing Wavelab 5, mastering with Waves X-Noise (learn mode) and  L3 Multimaximizer > rendered to 16 bit/44.1 KHz WAV using hi res CD settings > CDWAV 1.9 (tracking) > FLAC (level 8)
source: FOB Nak 100s > Sony D6 > Master Audience Cassette (TDK MA90s)

ai_review.summary: Audience recording with strong low‑end clarity captures an epic Fall ’85 tour performance.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers note a surprisingly clear and powerful audience tape, highlighting the pronounced bass “Phil bombs” and overall listenability despite venue acoustics. The show is remembered as part of an epic Fall 1985 run, delivering high energy even though no specific songs are singled out. Overall it’s a solid listening experience for fans seeking that era’s vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers rate the tape 3‑4 stars and praise the sound and performance; with limited detail, a solid but not outstanding rating is appropriate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great sounding audience tape with strong low‑end presence and clear bass; some venue muddiness noted but overall quite listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic performance typical of the Fall 85 tour; reviewers felt the show was epic even though no specific song moments were highlighted.

band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for "tons of Phil bombs" and strong low‑end bass presence.
